canon: 《意义智能：意义文明的认知操作系统》V7.0

L1.name: 减负
L1.question: 当信息供给远超认知带宽时，第一步该做什么？
L1.question_en: When information supply far exceeds cognitive bandwidth, what is the first thing to do?
L1.definition: 在不丢失决策所需关键结构的前提下，降低单位时间内的认知负荷总量。
L1.definition_en: Reduce total cognitive load per unit of time without losing the key structure needed for decision.
L1.anchor: 正典第1章 1.1；工具 A.1 意义自检卡
L1.anchor_en: Canon 1.1; Tool A.1 Meaning Self-Check Card

L2.name: 可体验
L2.question: 理解一个结构，最短的路径是什么？
L2.question_en: What is the shortest path to understanding a structure?
L2.definition: 把抽象关系转译为可操作、可回放的感知对象。
L2.definition_en: Translate abstract relations into operable, replayable perceptual objects.
L2.anchor: 正典第3章；第9章 M1 感知模块

L3.name: 意义生成
L3.question: 一堆已经看懂的材料，如何变成「对我意味着什么」？
L3.question_en: How does understood material become "what it means for me"?
L3.definition: 把材料组织为方向、价值、边界三个维度，并沿意义光谱带定位其抽象程度与时间尺度。
L3.definition_en: Organize material along direction, value, and boundary, and locate its level of abstraction and time scale along the meaning spectrum.
L3.anchor: 正典第3章 3.1/3.2；第8章 8.1 光谱带模型（取代固定层次）
L3.anchor_en: Canon 3.1/3.2; Ch.8 8.1 spectral band model (replaces fixed levels)

L4.name: 价值评估
L4.question: 这个意义判断有多可靠？凭什么？
L4.question_en: How reliable is this meaning judgment, and on what grounds?
L4.definition: 用统一标尺为意义判断标注证据强度与不确定性，并估计意义势能的变化方向。
L4.definition_en: Label judgments with evidence strength and uncertainty, and estimate the direction of meaning potential.
L4.anchor: 正典第6章 E0–E6；3.3 PE 方程
L4.anchor_en: Canon Ch.6 E0–E6; 3.3 the PE equation

L5.name: 方向选择
L5.question: 在多个都「有价值」的方向中，选哪一个？
L5.question_en: Among several directions that all have value, which one to choose?
L5.definition: 在五尺度框架下选定一个方向并显式承担其代价，同时输出修正触发条件。
L5.definition_en: Select one direction within the five scales while bearing its cost, and output correction triggers.
L5.anchor: 正典第4章五尺度；DC 指标；三级修正
L5.anchor_en: Canon Ch.4 five scales; DC indicator; three-level correction

L6.name: 反思与审视递归
L6.question: 谁来审视审视者？
L6.definition: 系统对自身的意义判断过程进行再判断，包括对判断框架本身的审查、周期性归零与重构。
L6.definition_en: The system re-judges its own meaning-judgment process, including review of the framework itself and periodic zeroing.
L6.anchor: 正典第7章 7B.2/7B.3/7B.4 三特性；附录D 表D.7 理论失败矩阵；H12/H13/H14
L6.anchor_en: Canon Ch.7 7B.2/7B.3/7B.4 three properties; Appendix D Table D.7 Theory Failure Matrix; H12/H13/H14
